d: When four young women go missing, police hunt for a serial killer roaming the interstate  John Quiñones explores the families' quests for answers.

st: Ruby Franke: From Momfluencer to Felon
d: Ruby Franke is a popular YouTuber known for her strict parenting  after her emaciated son escapes, begging for help, her seemingly perfect world implodes  featuring all-new body camera footage, recorded calls and a look at Ruby's private journal.

When a young couple is found dead, police learn they were involved in an online feud and uncover a deadly catfishing scheme  "20/20" untangles the web of lies and unmasks the unlikely mastermind behind the murders.

When a 16-year-old girl disappears, police have a surveillance video showing her getting into an unknown vehicle shortly after midnight  when the truth of her disappearance finally comes to light, the community is shocked by who is behind the plot.
A beloved small-town minister is found killed in his family home and his wife and three children are nowhere to be found.
